doubts: The page says the track starts at Mangatepopo Carpark and ends in Whakapapa Village for the 2026/27 Great Walk season, and that the circuit can be walked either direction. The main way follows the page's own order from Mangatepopo, with the reverse not a separate way. Mangatepopo Carpark is matched to road end F5 (where the Tongariro Crossing meets Mangatepopo Road); the text does not name a feature, so this is a judgement. The Whakapapa Village to Mangatepopo Hut section is closed for the 2026/27 season, so it is not in the via. The two return options from the Taranaki Falls loop junction are recorded: the lower waterfall route is the main way (it is presented first), and the upper section is W2 with its own 'about an hour' time. The Taranaki Falls loop junction has no feature or name entry, so its ref is null. Whakapapa Village is matched to the place entry T22, not the two identical Taranaki Falls road ends on Ngauruhoe Terrace, which are not certain to be the village end. The Soda Springs detour at the head of the valley has no place on the way it leaves from, so its from is null. The Mangatepopo Saddle, South Crater, Red Crater and Tama Saddle are not in the names list, so their refs are null. The time (3-4 days) and distance (35.5 km one way) are DOC's summary.
